inbox.ack.acked.note: hive_inbox ack's reply: what it acked. ids: their ids ("m12, m14").

inbox.ack.none.note: hive_inbox ack's reply when none of the ids was acked.

inbox.ack.notReadBefore.text: Not read before: {ids}, not acked: ack {n, plural, one {it} other {them}} once you have acted on {n, plural, one {it} other {them}}.
inbox.ack.notReadBefore.note: In hive_inbox ack's reply with read: true (#1531): ids it was asked to ack that the agent hadn't read, now in the read that follows. ids: their ids; n: how many.

inbox.ack.notReadYet.text: Not read yet: {ids}: read {n, plural, one {it} other {them}} with hive_inbox first.
inbox.ack.notReadYet.note: In hive_inbox ack's reply: ids it was asked to ack that the agent hasn't read. ids: their ids; n: how many.

inbox.ack.unknown.note: In hive_inbox ack's reply: ids it was asked to ack that aren't the agent's deliveries. ids: those ids.

inbox.again.launch.text: its session ended or restarted before it was read
inbox.again.launch.note: Why a delivery may repeat (#649), after the doorbell (inbox.offer.again), and in why it is uncertain (inbox.ended.uncertain).

inbox.again.restart.note: Why a delivery may repeat (#649), after the doorbell (inbox.offer.again): Hive stopped while it was being offered.

inbox.again.typing.note: Why a watch's wake may repeat (#649), after the doorbell (inbox.offer.again): Hive stopped while typing it.

inbox.cardEvents.counted.text: {n, plural, one {{count} change} other {{count} changes}}, read the card
inbox.cardEvents.counted.note: A card's events in one inbox item, counted (several changes to a watched card since the agent last read its inbox). n and count: how many.

inbox.cardEvents.withMore.text: {body} (with {more} more {n, plural, one {change} other {changes}}: read the card)
inbox.cardEvents.withMore.note: A card's events in one inbox item, led by the merge queue's return of the card while only comments came after it (HI-2087). body: the return's own line; n and more: how many events came after it.

inbox.create.badKey.text: Not a delivery Hive can keep: its source or key is too long.
inbox.create.badKey.note: Why a delivery isn't made: what names its producer is too long to keep.

inbox.create.full.text: This project's deliveries are full (what waits for its agents and isn't acked): wait until they are received and acked, or cancel some.
inbox.create.full.note: Why a delivery isn't made: its project's deliveries are full (the file's budget).

inbox.create.notSent.note: Why a delivery the Assistant left is refused when it is made. why: inbox.refused.controlDown or .assistantEnded.

inbox.create.projectFull.text: This project already has {max} deliveries waiting or not acked, the most Hive keeps.
inbox.create.projectFull.note: Why a delivery isn't made: its project has as many live deliveries as Hive keeps. max: that many.

inbox.create.tooLong.text: It is too long to give an agent ({length} characters, at most {max}).
inbox.create.tooLong.note: Why a delivery isn't made: its text is too long. length: its length; max: the most a delivery holds.

inbox.decisionEnded.agentGone.note: Why a line of new decisions was cancelled just before it was given: its agent was removed from the project.

inbox.decisionEnded.nothingNew.note: Why a line of new decisions was cancelled just before it was given: the agent has read them meanwhile, or its watch tells them.

inbox.decisionEnded.workspaceClosed.note: Why a line of new decisions (#401, a delivery) was cancelled just before it was given: its workspace closed.

inbox.ended.cancelledBy.note: Why a delivery was cancelled, as its sender reads it. by: who cancelled it (the user, an agent by name).

inbox.ended.doorbellLost.text: its doorbell was lost before its CLI took it
inbox.ended.doorbellLost.note: Why a delivery waits again, as its sender reads it: the line typed into its agent was lost before its CLI took it; it rings once more.

inbox.ended.notAcked.note: Why a delivery expired, as its sender reads it: its agent read it and never acked it.

inbox.ended.notWanted.note: Why a delivery was cancelled, as its sender reads it: what made it (its producer) no longer wants it given (#649).

inbox.ended.replaced.note: Why a delivery was cancelled, as its sender reads it: an action's newer delivery replaced it.

inbox.ended.tooLong.text: cancelled: made again, it was too long to keep
inbox.ended.tooLong.note: Why a delivery was cancelled, as its sender reads it: made again from its source just before it was given, it was too long (#649).

inbox.ended.uncertain.note: Why a delivery is uncertain (#649), as its sender reads it; it is offered once more. why: inbox.again.launch.

inbox.ended.uncertainRestart.text: may not have reached it: Hive stopped while offering it
inbox.ended.uncertainRestart.note: Why a delivery is uncertain (#649), as its sender reads it: Hive stopped while it was being offered; it is offered once more.

inbox.expired.late.note: Why a delivery expired, as its sender reads it: not read before its expiry.

inbox.expired.otherConversation.text: its agent is in another conversation now
inbox.expired.otherConversation.note: Why a delivery for one conversation of its agent expired, as its sender reads it.

inbox.expired.sessionEnded.text: the session it was for has ended
inbox.expired.sessionEnded.note: Why a delivery for one launch of its agent expired, as its sender reads it.

inbox.given.changed.text: what it was for changed meanwhile
inbox.given.changed.note: Why a delivery wanted now (a task, a handover's step) wasn't given: its caller no longer wants it.

inbox.given.notTyped.note: Why a delivery wanted now (a task, a handover's step) wasn't given, when nothing more is known.

inbox.load.failed.note: Why a project's deliveries couldn't be read, from its file from before #1018. error: the system's error.

inbox.loopEnded.notDue.note: Why a loop wake was cancelled just before it was given: the card moved on, the agent acted on it, or its own watch told it (#578).

inbox.loopEnded.otherAgent.text: it is another agent's wake now
inbox.loopEnded.otherAgent.note: Why a loop wake was cancelled just before it was given: the card's roles changed (another reviewer), and that agent gets it instead.

inbox.loopEnded.projectClosed.text: its project is no longer open
inbox.loopEnded.projectClosed.note: Why a loop wake was cancelled just before it was given: its workspace closed, or its window opened another.

inbox.loopEnded.unreadable.text: not a loop wake Hive can read
inbox.loopEnded.unreadable.note: Why a loop wake (#405, a delivery) was cancelled just before it was given: what it was made from can't be read back.

inbox.message.noText.note: A message left for an agent refused: its text (the tool's argument, text) is empty.

inbox.message.notRunning.note: #530: a message left for an agent (hive_message_agent) refused: the agent isn't running. agent: its name.

inbox.message.tooLong.text: A message is at most {max} characters (this one has {n}).
inbox.message.tooLong.note: A message left for an agent refused: too long. max: the most; n: its length.

inbox.message.tooMany.text: {agent} already has {max} messages waiting, the most Hive keeps for an agent: wait until they are delivered (hive_agent_activity), or cancel them.
inbox.message.tooMany.note: A message left for an agent refused: as many as Hive keeps for it already wait. agent: its name; max: how many.

inbox.noLine.cliAsks.text: its CLI shows a question for the user, which a line would answer
inbox.noLine.cliAsks.note: Why Hive could not type a line into an agent now (HI-1959), in the reply of the call that wanted it.

inbox.noLine.folder.note: Why Hive could not type a line into an agent now (#646), in the reply of the call that wanted it. what: what is changing the agent's folder (a Git switch or pull).

inbox.noLine.hooksMissing.text: its CLI's hooks aren't reaching Hive, so Hive can't tell when it is free
inbox.noLine.hooksMissing.note: Why Hive could not type a line into an agent now, in the reply of the call that wanted it.

inbox.noLine.inputBlocked.text: something on its screen is taking its keys, and it waits for the user to answer it there
inbox.noLine.inputBlocked.note: Why Hive could not type a line into an agent now (HI-2191), in the reply of the call that wanted it.

inbox.noLine.launchTask.text: its CLI hasn't taken its launch's task yet
inbox.noLine.launchTask.note: Why Hive could not type a line into an agent now, in the reply of the call that wanted it.

inbox.noLine.lineWaiting.text: its CLI hasn't taken the line Hive typed before
inbox.noLine.lineWaiting.note: Why Hive could not type a line into an agent now, in the reply of the call that wanted it.

inbox.noLine.notRunning.note: Why Hive could not type a line (a delivery given now, Deliver Now) into an agent, in the reply of the call that wanted it: the agent named.

inbox.noLine.status.note: Why Hive could not type a line into an agent now, in the reply of the call that wanted it. status: the agent's status, as Hive names it (working, starting…).

inbox.noLine.toolsWaiting.text: its hive tools haven't connected yet
inbox.noLine.toolsWaiting.note: Why Hive could not type a line into an agent now (#865), in the reply of the call that wanted it.

inbox.noLine.typing.text: Hive is already typing a line into it
inbox.noLine.typing.note: Why Hive could not type a line into an agent now, in the reply of the call that wanted it.

inbox.noLine.userTyping.text: the user has just typed in its terminal and may still be writing there
inbox.noLine.userTyping.note: Why Hive could not type a line into an agent now, in the reply of the call that wanted it.

inbox.noLine.wakeFirst.note: Why Hive could not type a line into an agent now (#1432): a watch's wake is being made for it, in the reply of the call that wanted it.

inbox.noLine.watching.text: it is waiting on cards, and takes no new work until it is woken
inbox.noLine.watching.note: Why Hive could not type a line into an agent now: it waits on a watch, in the reply of the call that wanted it.

inbox.offer.again.text: ({ids} again: {why}, so {n, plural, one {it} other {they}} may repeat.)
inbox.offer.again.note: After the doorbell: deliveries offered again, which the agent may have seen before. ids: their ids ("m12, m14"); why: why each is offered again, joined by "; " (inbox.again.*); n: how many.

inbox.offer.watchOn.text: (Your watch is still on, {watch}: do what this asks, then end your turn, and Hive wakes you when it changes.)
inbox.offer.watchOn.note: After the doorbell, typed into an agent waiting on a watch: its watch carries on. watch: the watch's label, its first letter in lower case ("waiting on HI-12").

inbox.read.ackEach.text: Ack each with hive_inbox (ack: its ids) once you have acted on it.
inbox.read.ackEach.note: hive_inbox's last line, after what is new.

inbox.read.newCount.note: hive_inbox's first line, before one line per item (ids · sender · card: text). count: how many items.

inbox.read.nothingNew.note: hive_inbox's reply when nothing is unread (before inbox.read.older, if any).

inbox.read.older.note: In hive_inbox's reply: deliveries the agent read before and has not acked. ids: their ids ("m12, m14").

inbox.refused.assistantEnded.text: the Assistant's session that left it ended
inbox.refused.assistantEnded.note: Why a delivery the Assistant left was refused, as its sender reads it.

inbox.refused.controlDown.text: the user turned Settings → Assistant → Control down
inbox.refused.controlDown.note: Why a delivery the Assistant left was refused, as its sender reads it: Control no longer lets it message agents.

inbox.refused.noInbox.text: {name} has no inbox: turn on the Agent API
inbox.refused.noInbox.note: Why an agent that can't read an inbox is given no delivery (#650's decision), as its sender sees it. name: the agent's name.

inbox.relay.check.text: For you to check: {said} If it grants a change {asker} can't make itself (Done past its rules, no code, skipping its review), make it, within any conditions it sets, with the answer as the reason; otherwise nothing is needed.
inbox.relay.check.note: The Assistant's line when the user answered or approved an agent's question and nothing on the card says what is needed (HI-1734): Hive never reads consent into a reply. said: what the user did (inbox.relay.said); asker: the asking agent's name.

inbox.relay.decision.text: Recorded as the card's decision, whole: <<<{decision}>>>
inbox.relay.decision.note: In the Assistant's line for the user's answer to an agent's question (HI-1734): the decision recorded on the card, never cut. After the reply (inbox.relay.reply), joined by ". ".

inbox.relay.declined.text: For your information: {said} The user declined: nothing is to be done for it.
inbox.relay.declined.note: The Assistant's line when the user declined an agent's question (HI-1734): never worded as a grant. said: what the user did (inbox.relay.said).

inbox.relay.needed.text: This needs you: {said} {asker} can't {need, select, done {move it to Done} noCode {make it no code} unblock {unblock it} other {skip its review}} by itself. {outcome, select, approved {Their approval is a yes, within any conditions its reply sets} other {Do it only if the answer agrees, within any conditions it sets}}, with the answer as the reason (hive_update_task).
inbox.relay.needed.note: The Assistant's line when the user answered or approved an agent's question on a card that needs what only the Assistant or the user can do (HI-1734). said: what the user did (inbox.relay.said); asker: the asking agent's name; need: done, noCode, unblock or skipReview; outcome: approved or answered.

inbox.relay.reply.note: In the Assistant's line for the user's answer to an agent's question (HI-1734): the user's reply, never cut (a condition at its end must reach whoever acts on it).

inbox.relay.replyIsDecision.text: Their reply, whole, recorded as the card's decision too: <<<{reply}>>>
inbox.relay.replyIsDecision.note: In the Assistant's line for the user's answer to an agent's question: an approval's note, which is its reply and the card's decision too, said once (HI-2286).

inbox.relay.said.text: the user {outcome, select, approved {approved} declined {declined} other {answered}} {asker}'s question on {card}. The question, whole: <<<{question}>>>.{wrote, select, yes { {words}.} answered {} other { Nothing was written with it.}} (Both stay on the card: hive_read_task {card}.)
inbox.relay.said.note: What the user did with an agent's question, in the Assistant's line (HI-1734), after its opening (inbox.relay.declined, .needed, .check). asker: the asking agent's name; card: its card (HI-12); question: the question, whole; wrote: yes with words (the reply and decision: inbox.relay.reply, .decision), answered for an answer with none, no for a bare approval or decline.

inbox.round.noCard.note: Why a message tied to a card's round (#652) isn't made. card: the card asked for (HI-12).

inbox.round.notInRound.text: {why}: a message tied to its round needs it in Doing or Review.
inbox.round.notInRound.note: Why a message tied to a card's round (#652) isn't made. why: why the card has no round under way (inbox.stale.*).

inbox.round.unreadable.note: Why a message tied to a card's round (#652) isn't made: the card can't be read now (its workspace closed). card: the card (HI-12).

inbox.save.dbReplaced.text: the workspace's database was replaced since these deliveries were read
inbox.save.dbReplaced.note: Why the deliveries couldn't be saved, in inbox.save.failed: an upgrade or a restore replaced the database.

inbox.save.failed.text: Hive couldn't save the deliveries ({error}): nothing changed.
inbox.save.failed.note: Why a change to deliveries (a message, a read, an ack, a cancel) failed. error: why the save failed (inbox.save.tooMany, .dbReplaced, or a system error).

inbox.save.tooMany.text: too many deliveries to keep in this project
inbox.save.tooMany.note: Why the deliveries couldn't be saved, in inbox.save.failed.

inbox.stale.archived.note: Why a delivery tied to a card's round is stale (#652). card: the card (HI-12).

inbox.stale.done.note: Why a delivery tied to a card's round is stale (#652). card: the card (HI-12).

inbox.stale.gone.note: Why a delivery tied to a card's round is stale (#652), as its sender reads it. card: the card (HI-12).

inbox.stale.left.note: Why a delivery tied to a card's round is stale (#652). card: the card (HI-12).

inbox.stale.passed.note: Why a delivery tied to a card's round is stale (#652). card: the card (HI-12).

inbox.stale.round.note: Why a delivery tied to a card's round is stale (#652): the card has moved to a later round. card: the card (HI-12); round: its round now.

inbox.watchEnded.cancelled.note: Why a watch's wake (a delivery) was cancelled, as its record says it. why: inbox.watchEnded.*, or why the watch was ended (the log's words).

inbox.watchEnded.ended.note: Why a watch's wake was cancelled just before it was given: its watch has ended meanwhile.

inbox.watchEnded.notSaved.text: cancelled: its watch couldn't be saved
inbox.watchEnded.notSaved.note: Why a watch's wake was cancelled as it was handed over: the watch could not be saved with it (it fires again).

inbox.watchEnded.replaced.note: Why a watch's wake was cancelled: the agent set another watch (in inbox.watchEnded.cancelled).

inbox.watchEnded.repliesOff.text: the user's replies are no longer told
inbox.watchEnded.repliesOff.note: #418, #1099: why a wake telling the Assistant a reply of the user's to an agent was cancelled: Settings → Assistant → Tell the Assistant when I reply to an agent was turned off.

inbox.watchEnded.watchCancelled.note: Why a watch's wake was cancelled: the agent or the user cancelled the watch (in inbox.watchEnded.cancelled).
